---
name: Good First Issue
about: A scoped, self-contained task for a new contributor
title: "[Area] Short, specific action"
labels: good first issue
---

## Problem
What's wrong or missing, with file/line references.

## Why it matters
Concrete impact — correctness, security, contributor experience, gas cost.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Specific, testable outcome 1
- [ ] Specific, testable outcome 2
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] CI green (fmt, clippy, audit, deny)

## Scope
Explicitly what's in/out of scope, so PRs don't sprawl.

## Definition of done
The single, concrete, verifiable condition that means this issue is finished.

---

**If you pick this issue up:** the pull request that closes it needs a **detailed
description** — what was wrong, the approach you took, anything the reviewer
should look at closely, and how you verified it. A one-line description will be
sent back before review. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
